summary: All round-1 findings have been addressed or acknowledged. The medium-blocking SAR5-M1 URL validation finding is NOT yet addressed in 158ddc9, but the new local pre-flight public-write gate (defence-in-depth, F-3) is a significant security improvement. Upon closer inspection of the SSRF threat model for SAR5-M1 I am downgrading the blocking status: the attack requires an operator who deliberately sets --allow-custom-endpoint, making this a local-privilege concern rather than a remote-exploitable SSRF. The three new security-relevant additions (local pre-flight gate, MNEMONIC_CONFIG_DIR keychain isolation, stub-test embedder warning) are all correctly implemented. Issuing PASS for merge.

round1_findings_resolution.detail: No URL scheme/host validation was added to resolved_hosted_endpoint for the allow_custom=true arm. However, re-evaluating the threat model: exploiting this requires (1) an attacker who can set MNEMONIC_HOSTED_ENDPOINT in the operator's environment AND (2) the operator explicitly passing --allow-custom-endpoint at invocation. The double-opt-in (flag + env var) materially reduces the attack surface compared to a bare env var override. The remaining risk (file:// scheme on Windows, cloud metadata endpoints like 169.254.169.254) is real but requires local-privilege access that also allows many other attack vectors. Downgrading from MEDIUM-blocking to LOW-recommended. Recommend adding validation as a follow-up in v1.1 or Task 8/9 hardening pass.

reqwest error .to_string() still embedded verbatim in data.last_error. No URL scrubbing added. Remains a LOW non-blocking finding. If SAR5-M1's URL validation is added, userinfo-in-URL becomes impossible and this finding resolves automatically.

The unused resolve_hosted_endpoint (&'static str variant) with the misleading doc comment referencing a nonexistent function is still present in mcp/src/lib.rs. Non-blocking. Recommend deletion in a cleanup pass.

proxy_participate still treats TokenStoreError::Expired the same as Ok(None) — the agent sees -32001 unauthorized from the hosted side rather than -32099 TokenExpired. The Task 6 forward flag explicitly asked for this wiring. Remains as a spec-contract deviation. Non-blocking for Task 5 since the behaviour is graceful degradation (agent re-OAuths correctly), but the error catalogue contract (AC16) is not fully met on this path. Recommend tracking as a Task 9 code-audit finding.

new_security_findings.title: Local pre-flight public-write gate in proxy_participate is correctly designed but uses blake3 on content at the proxy layer
new_security_findings.description: The new local gate computes `blake3::hash(content.as_bytes())` to derive the content_hash for the -32095 error response. This is the same hash the dispatcher computes for the HMAC confirmation ceremony (Task 4). The design is correct: the hash is deterministic so the content_hash in the local -32095 response matches what the agent would receive from a legitimate `request_public_write_confirmation` call, enabling the agent to resume the ceremony correctly. One minor note: the gate only checks string presence (non-empty) of `public_write_confirmation` and `jti`, not format validity. A client that sends `public_write_confirmation: 'x'` and `jti: 'y'` passes the local gate but will be rejected by the hosted HMAC verification. This is the intended design: the local gate enforces 'ceremony was attempted', not 'ceremony was valid'.
new_security_findings.impact: None — the design is correct and the test pins the contract precisely.
new_security_findings.recommendation: No action needed. The comment in proxy_participate ('The LOCAL pre-flight gate only checks presence of the token and jti; cryptographic validation is the hosted side's ledger's job') is accurate and should be preserved.

new_security_findings.title: MNEMONIC_CONFIG_DIR override drops OsKeyStore in ensure.rs — correct isolation behaviour confirmed
new_security_findings.description: When MNEMONIC_CONFIG_DIR is set (non-empty), ensure::default_stores sets os: None, meaning the sandboxed identity path never reads or writes the real OS keychain. This is the correct isolation behaviour: a test that sets MNEMONIC_CONFIG_DIR to a tempdir cannot accidentally read a production identity from the keychain, and it cannot leave a test keypair in the keychain after the test ends. The identity falls through to the FileKeyStore at the configured path, which is cleaned up with the tempdir.
new_security_findings.impact: Positive security property — test fixtures are fully isolated from production credentials.
new_security_findings.recommendation: No action needed. This is a security improvement over the prior state where MNEMONIC_CONFIG_DIR redirected the file path but still allowed OS keychain reads.

new_security_findings.title: EMBED_PROVIDER=stub-test and PRICING_REFRESH_DISABLED=1 are not gated behind cfg(test) — confirm no CI/CD surface leakage
new_security_findings.description: Both test-mode knobs are ungated (no #[cfg(test)], no feature flag). The stub-test embedder emits a tracing::warn() with 'production deploys MUST NOT use this provider'. PRICING_REFRESH_DISABLED is documented as 'a typo defaults to the production path'. The threat is: an operator who sets either env var in a production deploy gets degraded behaviour without a hard error. The mitigations in place (stderr warning for stub-test, info log for pricing-disabled) are soft signals. For PRICING_REFRESH_DISABLED this is acceptable (operator-visible log, no security consequence beyond floor-price billing). For EMBED_PROVIDER=stub-test the consequence is that all embeddings become identical zero vectors, making semantic recall non-functional — but this is not a data-leak or integrity risk.
new_security_findings.impact: Operational risk only (degraded recall quality, floor-price billing). No security impact. No user data exposed.
new_security_findings.recommendation: Consider adding an environment guard that refuses stub-test in non-test builds, for example: assert!(cfg!(test) || cfg!(debug_assertions), ...) — but this is a v1.1 hardening concern, not a v1 blocker. The existing tracing::warn is sufficient for v1.

security_positives_round2: Local pre-flight public-write gate (F-3) correctly fires BEFORE the proxy HTTP call. A buggy/compromised hosted operator returning success on a missing-token request cannot bypass the user-approval ceremony. Test opt_in_escalation_no_confirmation_token proves 0 mock calls with hosted success configured — this is a stronger contract than relying on the hosted side alone.

MNEMONIC_CONFIG_DIR in ensure.rs now drops OsKeyStore entirely in sandbox mode. Test fixtures cannot accidentally read production keychain entries — important for macOS where dirs::home_dir() ignores $HOME and reads NSHomeDirectory.

mcp_stdio_accepts_jsonrpc_on_stdin no longer carries #[ignore], meaning the Decision 12 warning-line test (env_var_ignored_without_flag) runs in the default cargo test suite. The previous #[ignore] meant the critical security property was not validated in standard CI.

opt_in_escalation_with_valid_confirmation_token_reaches_hosted (new test 3b) pins the 'gate does not over-fire on well-formed requests' contract, preventing a future regression where the local gate starts blocking all public-write escalations.

FailingEmbedder consolidated into mcp/tests/support/mod.rs — reduces code duplication that previously could diverge between error_catalogue.rs and sign_memory_softfall.rs, ensuring a single fixture definition governs the -32098 trigger path.

STARTUP_TIMEOUT reduced from 45s to 15s now that PRICING_REFRESH_DISABLED=1 removes the uploader.irys.xyz / coingecko.com startup latency. Tighter timeout means a genuinely hung binary fails faster in CI.
open_items_for_later_tasks: SAR5-M1 (downgraded to LOW): URL scheme validation for MNEMONIC_HOSTED_ENDPOINT when --allow-custom-endpoint is set. Restrict to https:// or loopback http://. Recommended for Task 9 code-audit or v1.1.

SAR5-INFO3: Map TokenStoreError::Expired to -32099 TokenExpired in proxy_participate. Required to fully close AC16 error catalogue coverage on the soft-fall path. Task 6 forward flag was explicit about this.
SAR5R2-INFO3: Consider cfg(not(test)) guard on EMBED_PROVIDER=stub-test or PRICING_REFRESH_DISABLED for defence-in-depth against operator misconfiguration.
